Plumbing Warehouse position $25.00-$32.00 per hour. Medical/401k/PTO (dublin / pleasanton / livermore)

7640 National Dr. near Greenville

google map

compensation: Commensuruate with experience.
employment type: full-time
experience level: mid level
job title: Warehouseman

QR Code Link to This Post

Fault Line Plumbing is a family owned, mid-size construction-plumbing firm with an emphasis on large commercial/industrial, restaurants, retail tenant-improvement. We serve customers throughout California, with an emphasis on projects in the SF Bay Area and Central Valley (Sacramento – Modesto). We have a solid 25 years in business with a reputation of providing consistent, dependable service to our customers, a commitment to investing in the development of our team members, and a plan to grow the company significantly in the coming years.
We are looking for a full time Warehouse/Purchasing Associate that will report to our Project Coordinator and handle all incoming and outgoing job related materials in the Livermore Office to ensure materials for jobs are properly staged, tools are tracked and properly maintained, warehouse area is clean, neat and organized and all job related documentation is accurate and current.
Requirements:
· 1 - 3 years of work experience
· Fluency in English (spoken and written); able to speak Spanish (preferred)
· Valid California state driver’s license
· High School Diploma or equivalent
· Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
· Good mental arithmetic skills, ability to keep accurate and up-to-date records
· Competency in Microsoft Office applications, and google docs
· Capable of doing self directed work; to start and persist in specific tasks while exhibiting high motivation
· Able to communicate with others in a warm and helpful manner
· Able to lift 50-lbs over head & Forklift experience

Responsibilities:
· Work with Project Coordinator to execute material purchases for jobs
· Pull and stage all materials as requested by field staff
· Maintain electronic job folders for all documentation pertaining to materials used in jobs
· Verify that all materials delivered to the shop match purchase orders and resolve shorts and extras
· Verify that all materials slated for delivery are present and loaded onto delivery truck or staged in an appropriate area with proper labels
· Maintain job box inventories, tool registrations log, finish tote inventories and vehicle log.
· Arrange for retrieval of tools purchased by employees, inspect all returning tools, ensure tools are functional and properly maintained
· Keep warehouse premise neat, clean and organized

Compensation:
· $52,000 to $66,800 a year, depending on experience

Benefits:
· 401K
· Vacation pay
· Paid holidays
· Paid sick days
· Regular reviews and opportunities for wage increases and promotions
All applicants are subject to examination, both oral and written, to test knowledge of plumbing material and software literacy.

All new employees are subject to termination at will.

If you would like to join our team, please email your resume to the “reply-to” link above.
